11. The Great Inventor

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager crosses the village to fetch something important and forgets what it was.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) walks across the village to fetch something important. Upon arriving, (subject.he/she) realizes that (subject.he/she) has completely forgotten what it was. (subject) stands motionless, staring at a basket, hoping the basket will provide an answer.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) walks all the way back to the hut. The moment (subject.he/she) reaches the doorway, (subject.he/she) remembers: a needle! Triumphant, (subject) returns to the workshop. Then (subject.he/she) realizes the needle is still in the hut.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: "What did I come here for?" (subject) asks. "How would I know?" replies (friend). They consider the question together. After several minutes (friend) suggests lunch. (subject) agrees that lunch sounds like an excellent idea, whether or not it was the original purpose.
